page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top, with the page number at top left. Running text in one column, with one margin note in the left margin beside the last paragraph. Heading "De Laudatorijs Epistolis" centred above the last paragraphs.

l.i: IIII. Itaque, ut maximè eas laudo probóq; : ita
quod mittere mihi volueris tibi gratias, quas po-
ssum ago maximas: relaturus cum primum aliqua se-
se obtulerit occasio.
V. Quod enim mirari me arbitraris, cur in con-
trariis te orationibus exerceas, liberare omnino te
solicitudine volo.
VI. Nota mihi veterum hac in re est confuetudo:
quid Aristoteles, Cicero, Q-
uintilianus, aliiq; dicēdi
magistri hoc de exercitationis genere scribant, scio:
perspecta eiusdem insignis mihi utilitas est.
VII. A me autem quod exigis: pari par ut refe-
ram: plus amori in me tuo, quam vero judicio tri-
buis.
VIII. Veruntamen, quia omnino à me hoc po-
stulas, tentabo sane aliquid: Sed χρύσεα χαλκείων:
& Diomedis atq; Glauci permutatio erit.
IX. Veruntamen hunc ipsum, ut spero, æqui bo-
niq; conatum consules: simul etiam pluribus in lu-
cem scriptis tuis emittendis: & bene de bonorū ado-
lescentum studijs mereri: & surgenti tuæ consulere
gloriæ conaberis.

main_text.l: καὶ appellatæ, sunt quæ, vel persona-
rum, vel factorum, vel rerum laudem, atq;

page.notes: Long s is transcribed as s throughout (e.g. "folicitudine" as solicitudine, "fcribant" as scribant, "perfpecta" as perspecta, "magistri" as magistri). The Greek "χρύσεα χαλκείων" and "ἐπαινετι-καὶ" are read from a small scan and should be checked against the original. The printed hyphen in "ἐπαινετι-" is assumed. "IX. ... lu-cem" and "ado-lescentum" are printed hyphens at line ends. The heading is treated as a level 2 title above a passage. The page ends mid-sentence with no catchword or signature.
